title: Family Meeting Study for End Stage Renal Disease
brief_summary: A randomized clinical trial for patients with end stage renal disease in which a family consultation condition is compared against a treatment as usual control condition on the hospital readmissions after 1 month as the primary outcome variable.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Hospitalized in inpatient Nephrology Unit at Henry Ford Hospital
* Has end-stage renal disease
* Willing and able to contact support person / family member about participating in the study

Exclusion Criteria:

* Persistent Delirium
* Non-English speaking
